hastestone.config.title: Hastestone Settings
hastestone.config.category.deepslate.des: Instant mining with Haste II and mining at stone speed.
hastestone.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When OFF, mining is exactly vanilla.
hastestone.config.deepslate_instant.tool: With Haste II (a beacon, a potion...), deepslate breaks at once whenever stone would with the same pickaxe and enchantments.
Deepslate takes exactly as long to mine as stone does with the same tool, with or without a beacon. Wood, stone, iron, diamond and netherite pickaxes each keep their own stone timing.
hastestone.config.cobblestone_instant.to: With Haste II, cobblestone breaks at once whenever stone would, as in Bedrock Edition. Without this, Java cobblestone is harder than stone and never breaks instantly.
